sloka: तस्याहं स्वर्गिणो वाक्यं श्रुत्वा दुःखसमन्वितम् ।तारणायोपजग्राह तदाभरणमुत्तमम् ।। ७.७८.२७ ॥
transliteration: tasyāhaṁ svargiṇo vākyaṁ śrutvā duḥkhasamanvitam ।tāraṇāyopajagrāha tadābharaṇamuttamam ।। 7.78.27 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the sorrowful plea of that king who desired heaven, I accepted his excellent ornament for the purpose of his liberation.
